title: WidthProcessor - M/S width, mono-lows-preserved reconstruction
description:
Implement Source/DSP/WidthProcessor only. Post-assembly M/S width (§4.7) that cannot move shared lows off-center.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/ShredWidth_Build_Spec.md §4.7 (M/S math and mono-lows proof), §5 width range 0–200% → factor [0,2], §6 ~20 ms smoothing

Implement class WidthProcessor in Source/DSP/WidthProcessor.h + WidthProcessor.cpp:
1. API: prepare(sampleRate) [for smoother], reset(), setWidth(float width01or02), processSample(float inL, float inR, float& outL, float& outR) and/or block process.
2. Math exactly: M=(yL+yR)/2, S=(yL-yR)/2, yL'=M+width*S, yR'=M-width*S with width clamped to [0, 2]. width=0 mono; width=1 identity; width=2 side doubled.
3. Accept either 0–2 linear factor or 0–200 percent mapped to [0,2] — document in header; tests will use [0,2] factor.
4. Optional juce::SmoothedValue ~20 ms on width to avoid zipper (safe and matches §6).
5. No filtering here — mono-lows preservation is by construction when LP was shared upstream (do not reimplement crossover).
6. RT-safe; no allocation outside prepare;

Do not implement other DSP classes, tests, or CMakeLists.
acceptance_criteria: WidthProcessor applies M=(L+R)/2, S=(L-R)/2, L'=M+w*S, R'=M-w*S with w clamped to [0,2]
width=1 yields identity (within float tolerance) for arbitrary L/R inputs
prepare/reset/process API present; no allocation outside prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify DelayLineFrac, PitchShifter, MonoSafetyCrossover, PluginProcessor, PluginEditor
apply frequency-dependent width or reimplement crossover
move lows via additional M/S EQ

allowed: map 0–200% to [0,2] or take [0,2] directly with clear docs
forbidden: add stereo imaging beyond §4.7 M/S scale
